subject: Post-call: rescue & ownership - need locked time or we'll assign
messages:
From: Soojin Lee <soojin_lee@redwood.ai>
To: Samira Khan <samira@novafabric.com>
Cc: Grace O'Connor <grace_oconnor@redwood.ai>
Date: Wed, 04 Nov 2026 09:12:00 -0700
Subject: Post-call: rescue & ownership - need locked time or we'll assign

Hi Samira —

Great to speak this morning. Quick recap and proposed next steps from our discovery:

- Primary objectives: reduce model inference cost by ~40% and meet sub-200ms median latency for support use cases.
- Constraints: must run within Azure US-West and integrate with existing SSO + audit logging.
- Success criteria: pilot serving 10k requests/day with clear cost per 1k tokens and observability dashboards.

Next step: technical deep-dive with our infra engineer to validate KV cache behavior and batching profile. I have two engineers available to present: one can walk architecture and the other will run a short live perf demo.

Can you lock one of these 30-minute windows today? We have tight capacity for end-of-week engineering time, so I need a firm yes or we will assign the slot to another priority pilot. Proposed slots (all PDT):

1) 11:30–12:00
2) 15:00–15:30
3) Tomorrow 09:00–09:30

If none of these work, please tell me which people will attend and propose two concrete alternatives today. If we don't get confirmation within 2 hours, we'll rotate the slot to the next pipeline opportunity and circle back next week.

Attachments: novafabric-deepdive-agenda-v2.pdf (agenda), mutual-action-plan.xlsx (proposed milestones).

Thanks — appreciate quick turnaround.

— Soojin
Soojin Lee
Account Exec, Redwood Inference
soojin_lee@redwood.ai | +1 (415) 555-0142

From: Samira Khan <samira@novafabric.com>
To: Soojin Lee <soojin_lee@redwood.ai>
Date: Wed, 04 Nov 2026 10:05:00 -0700
Subject: Re: Post-call: rescue & ownership - need locked time or we'll assign

Soojin —

I'm really sorry — Alex and I had a calendar conflict and we missed the follow-up. Thanks for the recap.

11:30 today is tight for us (back-to-back), but 15:00–15:30 should work if you can keep the demo lean (15–20 mins for tech + 10 mins Q&A). I'll confirm in 30 if there are no other conflicts. If someone else needs the slot, please reassign and we'll find another time.

— Samira
Head of OPS, Nova Fabric
samira@novafabric.com

(On mobile)
From: Soojin Lee <soojin_lee@redwood.ai>
To: Samira Khan <samira@novafabric.com>
Cc: Grace O'Connor <grace_oconnor@redwood.ai>, Marissa Cole <marissa_cole@redwood.ai>
Date: Wed, 04 Nov 2026 10:15:00 -0700
Subject: Re: Post-call: rescue & ownership - need locked time or we'll assign

Thanks Samira — appreciate the quick reply. 15:00–15:30 PDT is tentatively held. We'll slim the deck: 12-minute architecture overview, 8-minute live perf demo, 10-minute Q&A.

Two asks so we can arrive focused:
- Please confirm Alex can attend (abennett@novafabric.com).
- Are there any specific SSO/KMS constraints we should surface to engineering before the call?

Grace — looping you in to confirm engineering ownership and to step in if we need to move the slot (Marissa, FYI on capacity). If Samira confirms in the next 45 minutes we'll lock and send an invite. If we don't hear back, we'll release the slot and propose tomorrow morning.

Best,
— Soojin

From: Samira Khan <samira@novafabric.com>
To: Soojin Lee <soojin_lee@redwood.ai>, Grace O'Connor <grace_oconnor@redwood.ai>
Cc: Alex Bennett <abennett@novafabric.com>
Date: Wed, 04 Nov 2026 11:37:00 -0700
Subject: Re: Post-call: rescue & ownership - need locked time or we'll assign

All —

Confirmed. 15:00–15:30 PDT works for Alex and me. We'll join with the ops lead and a security engineer on mute for the first 20 minutes; they'll drop in if there are infra questions. No special KMS constraints beyond our standard (Azure Key Vault, tenant-level policies) — I'll share the specifics in a short note before the meeting.

Looking forward to the demo and the mutual-action-plan. Please send the calendar invite when you have it.

— Samira
